title: Policy-Driven Reconciliation
intent: Enable approval_required and auto_apply reconciliation modes through the shared desired-state runtime lifecycle helper.

observed_before.reconciler: Recorded observations and drift but did not invoke the desired-state deploy helper for auto_apply, and approval_required did not project a distinct remediation-needed state.
observed_before.locking: Deploy/apply used RuntimeApplyLock; scheduled reconciliation did not participate in the same lock path.

intended_behavior.observe_only: Observe and record drift without remediation.
intended_behavior.approval_required: Observe drift, mark state remediation_needed, and wait for authorized kind 5968 DriftRemediate.
intended_behavior.auto_apply: Apply the persisted desired state through RuntimeLifecycleService.AutoRemediateDesiredState.
intended_behavior.lock_contention: User deploy/apply holds the blocking environment lock; scheduled auto-remediation attempts the same lock non-blocking, records backoff on contention, and retries later.
intended_behavior.failure: Desired state remains persisted; failure metadata and reconcile backoff are stored on environment_service_state.
